editing_rules: Edit only the group that owns a feature, not the whole flattened picture.
Canonical relationships stay unchanged unless user explicitly revises lore; exact coastline of central continent remains a candidate even if displayed prominently.
If changing a land mask or heightmap, revalidate drainage divisions, rivers, coastal samples and geomorphology before exporting a new release.
Global oceans list 25 official names with no binding to specific water polygons until location is selected.
Keep independent R1/R2 river systems, do not connect Tangxi to either without explicit canon.
Candidate continent 2 river-mouth overlay is noncanonical and can be disabled independently.
Without a real orbital/climate model, do not introduce definitive planet-wide rainfall, latitude belts or administrative borders.
SVG is structurally editable in a vector editor; the companion HTML viewer only toggles layers and navigates and cannot directly move polygon vertices.
notes: Central polygon and settlement LABELS are inherited from V1.9: illustrated locations are NOT actual city coordinates. The 8 outer candidate masses follow the existing V2.3 L0-L4 design drawings. The terrain layer currently includes preserved relative elevation bands but no calibrated relief metric. Ocean and land are shape-based, not topological Earth projections.
